english_page_recheck.current_title: Wireless Xbox One Controller Bumper Assembly Replacement
english_page_recheck.finding: Current English title and introduction correctly identify the bumper assembly. Earlier mismatch observation applies to the recorded French page, not every language/version of this guide.

download: Direct NETWORK_INTERFACE, proxy disabled; real IP 3.170.221.87 obtained from AliDNS HTTPS resolver at 223.5.5.5

images.observation: A finger lifts one end of the transverse upper bumper strip. A spring and rear trigger assembly remain below it. Arrows describe removal, not gameplay motion.
The detached part spans both top shoulders and has a narrow connecting web. Two rear trigger bodies remain on the chassis.

decision.reason: The title and step text call the removed part triggers, but inspected pictures show the LB/RB bumper bridge. Do not infer LT/RT axis positions from these removal arrows.
decision.supersedes: Earlier conversational suggestion that guide 157833 steps 7-8 could directly establish trigger hinge construction.

validation: Both downloaded images visually inspected; SHA256 recorded. No pixel measurement, photogrammetry or mechanical fit has been performed.
